data.exact_reserve_text: An overall deterioration of GBP 3.7 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Deteriorations of GBP 11.5 million on third party liability, GBP 4.3 million on energy and GBP 3.4 million on pecuniary loss were largely offset by an improvement of GBP 17.5 million on reinsurance acceptances.

prior_year_events.impact_description: There has been significant creep in the size of the Typhoon Jebi loss that occurred in 2018, which also impacted Syndicate 2121 on a gross basis; this loss was recoverable under the reinsurance programme at year end 2018 and the net position has improved due to the structure of the reinsurance protections purchased.

named_events.loss_description: The largest natural catastrophe loss incurred by the syndicate was in respect of Typhoon Hagibis
The syndicate was impacted by Typhoons Hagibis and Faxai out of Japan
Hurricane Dorian, which greatly threatened the US but veered east at the final moment massively reducing the potential damage
major bushfires affecting large parts of Australia that continued into 2020
the largest incurred man-made loss being turbine damage from the utility class

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall deterioration on prior years' reserves of GBP 3.7m in 2019 (a net strengthening). The movement was driven by adverse development in third party liability (GBP 11.5m), energy (GBP 4.3m) and pecuniary loss (GBP 3.4m), partially offset by a favourable movement of GBP 17.5m on reinsurance acceptances. Named catastrophe events in 2018-2019 (notably Typhoon Jebi in 2018 and Typhoon Hagibis, Faxai, Townsville flooding, Hurricane Dorian and the Australian bushfires in 2019) influenced claims experience, and reinsurance recoveries mitigated parts of the ultimate net exposure.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year movement figure used is the explicitly stated overall deterioration of GBP 3.7m in the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (page 36). The report also lists component movements (third party liability GBP 11.5m, energy GBP 4.3m, pecuniary loss GBP 3.4m, reinsurance acceptances improvement GBP 17.5m) which do not arithmetically sum to the stated overall deterioration (19.2 - 17.5 = 1.7m vs stated 3.7m), implying other smaller movements not itemised in the narrative. The prior year movement is therefore taken from the explicit overall statement. The claims development triangle is present (gross amounts in GBP '000) and was not used as the primary source for PYD because the narrative provides a clear overall gross figure; the triangle is included below for reference. Some mapping (e.g. 'Pecuniary loss'  'Professional Lines') is approximate. All monetary amounts in the top-level fields are in millions per instructions.
